context.description: Liveness comes from the status tags and the heartbeat

evidence.trustReason: The real taskView machine is tested at heartbeat ages 15,000 and 15,001 ms, with absent heartbeat, ended tag and absent file; its disk feed also changes live to still to live to ended to absent. The real plugin on a session route receives Tab, watch and esc keys with a fresh heartbeat and an owned harness child: selection and navigation occur and the root aborts. The same keys are asserted inert with no owned child, a stale or absent heartbeat, an ended run and no file; Tab instead reaches the agent binding. A separately driven machine checks that an armed stop key disarms when liveness ends. The test therefore covers each Gherkin step with observable positive and negative behavior.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI3 Liveness comes from the status tags and the heartbeat
    Given a status file
    When the run lacks the ended tag and its heartbeat is at most 15 seconds old
    Then the view is live, and Tab, esc twice and the watch keys act on the run when the session owns its harness sessions
    And an older or absent heartbeat makes the view still, an ended run makes it ended, and no file makes it absent
    And the run keys leave a run alone when the view is not live or the session does not own it

  @phase4 @core @edge @ASSUMPTION:A2.a
